description: Defines abstract classes and interfaces for managing index buffers in Direct3D rendering within the ANGLE project, including classes for buffer management, serialization, and different buffer usage strategies.

classes.name: IndexBuffer
classes.description: Abstract class for managing an index buffer in Direct3D, including initialization, mapping, unmapping, and size management.

classes.name: IndexBufferInterface
classes.description: Interface for buffer management, including reserving space, mapping, unmapping, and retrieving buffer info.

classes.name: StreamingIndexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for streaming index buffers with specific reservation strategy.

classes.name: StaticIndexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for static index buffers with specific reservation strategy.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the index buffer with context, size, type, and dynamic flag.

methods.name: mapBuffer
methods.description: Maps the buffer memory for access.

methods.name: getIndexType
methods.description: Returns the type of indices stored.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size and type of the buffer.

methods.name: getSerial
methods.description: Returns the serial number of the buffer.

methods.name: IndexBufferInterface
methods.description: Constructor for buffer interface, managing buffer reservation and access.

methods.name: getWritePosition
methods.description: Gets current write position in buffer.

methods.name: setWritePosition
methods.description: Sets current write position in buffer.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the buffer size and type.
